name: Stage 52: Nynäs slott to Sandviks badplats
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 52, Nynäs slott to Sandviks badplats.
utilities: Nynäs slott provides the start-side service cluster: parking, toilets, seasonal restaurant/cafe, Bränneriet lodging, gardens/visitor context, and road-219 bus access; 2026 public visitor season is 20 June-16 August, Wednesday-Sunday 11-16, but food and indoor services still need a current check.

Brevik/Nynäs brygga is the mid-stage camping/service node with summer tap, toilet, parking, fireplace, picnic/waste context, and designated tenting; current Nynäs rules limit tenting to marked grass areas because of 2026 renovation work.

Sandviks badplats and Sandviks camping are separate nearby service nodes: the stage junction/beach/tap is east by the badplats, while the paid camping/service-building area with showers, electricity, waste/recycling context, and camping rules is west of it.
waterSources: Official drinking-water taps are seasonal: Brevik after about 2.5 km at N 58°47.819 E 017°22.797 and Sandviks badplats/camping at N 58°47.708 E 017°25.089.

Do not treat Brevik or Sandvik taps as year-round. A recent official-page user comment reported water at the castle/Brevik, but that should be treated as opening-hour/visitor-service context rather than all-hours trail water.

Tvären/Baltic water and small wetlands are natural/salt-brackish water context only, not practical drinking-water refills. Sandviks badplats bathing water had 2025 samples listed as tjänligt and 2026 season classification as good, but check current bathing-water status in season.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 7.5 km; Naturkartan measures about 7.0 km/7,025 m, OSM relation 7449057 computes about 6.862 km, Äventyrligare about 6.83 km, and local official-GPX geometry is about 6.958 km. Keep 7.5 km as the planning distance and use measured length as map metadata.

Stage 52 and Stage 53 snap exactly in local geometry at Sandviks badplats, while OSM Stage 52 ends about 52 m west of the local shared point. Stage 53:1 does not share the exact Stage 52/53 endpoint; it starts about 230-245 m east along the early Stage 53/Sandvik area, so a route from Stage 52 to 53:1 should include or snap across that short connector.

Expect a more demanding Nynäs-reserve day than the short distance suggests: rocky knolls just after the castle, a road crossing, old cart road, a noticeable climb, boulder/shingle field, giant's kettle, Röstensberget viewpoint, shore sections, and road/path sections. Wet rocks, repeated climbs/descents, and high grass can slow the route.
Cattle may occur in at least one pasture. Keep dogs controlled, use gates/passages correctly, and avoid disturbing livestock.

The official page showed no current fault reports during the research pass. User reports describe a possible missed-sign point shortly after Nynäs slott, side-road/cottage-area wrong-turn risk near Sandvik, clear but attention-demanding markings, the Tvärens/Lövnösudden shelter in good condition with firewood reported by one hiker, and wider Nynäs Runt junctions as places where GPS/attention helps.

Sandviks badplats is a useful endpoint with sea bathing, parking, toilet, grill/fireplace, changing-room context, and seasonal water. HaV lists the latest 2025 sample as tjänligt with no algal bloom and the 2026 season classification as good, but check current samples during the official 2026 bathing season, especially after rain or visible algae.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott stage start
facilities.description: Official stage 52 start and stage 51 end at Nynäs slott.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott services
facilities.description: Seasonal visitor services, restaurant/cafe context, gardens, and castle/manor destination. Research noted 2026 visitor season as 20 June-16 August, Wednesday-Sunday 11-16; verify current restaurant/cafe status before relying on it.

facilities.name: Restaurang Nynäs / seasonal food
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe service at Nynäs with 2026 visitor-season context of 20 June-16 August, Wednesday-Sunday 11-16. Verify opening the same day, especially outside summer.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott parking
facilities.description: Start-side parking for Nynäs slott and the reserve. Several reserve car parks exist; follow signs.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott south parking
facilities.description: Additional mapped Nynäs visitor-area parking close to the castle/service cluster and stage start.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott toilets
facilities.description: Mapped toilets in the Nynäs visitor area; opening/season may vary.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott south toilet
facilities.description: Additional mapped visitor-area toilet near the castle/service cluster. Verify opening and season.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott middle toilet
facilities.description: Additional mapped visitor-area toilet between parking and castle. Verify opening and season.

facilities.name: STF Bränneriet / Nynäs lodging
facilities.description: Hostel and booked lodging by Rundbosjön; Sörmlandsleden passes nearby. Book ahead and do not treat guest services as public all-hours water.

facilities.name: Nynäs bus stop
facilities.description: Bus access along road 219, about 500 m from the castle/park. Line 554 is the key Nynäs corridor between Vagnhärad/Nyköping/Studsvik; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Nynäs bus stop opposite platform
facilities.description: Opposite-direction bus platform along road 219 for Nynäs reserve access, about 500 m from the castle/park. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station train access
facilities.description: Official access planning uses Vagnhärad railway station with bus/taxi onward travel. It is far from both stage ends, so show as remote rail access rather than a trail-adjacent stop.

facilities.name: Nynäs north hill bench/view
facilities.description: A 2025 official-page user comment recommends the hill north of the castle as a bench/view rest point. Approximate pin.

facilities.name: Rocky climb after Nynäs
facilities.description: The route climbs rocky knolls shortly after the castle and later has a notable ascent after an old cart-road section. Use care in wet/icy conditions.

facilities.name: Early Stage 52 sign watch
facilities.description: A hiker report flags one early point after Nynäs slott where it is easy to miss the Sörmlandsleden sign. Watch orange markers closely around the castle-side paths and roads.

facilities.name: Brevik designated tent site
facilities.description: Official mid-stage designated tenting area by the road toward Nynäs brygga. From 2026-03-16, Nynäs limits tenting to designated grass areas, max one night, during renovation work; caravans/campervans should use Sandviks camping. Follow posted signs.

facilities.name: Brevik summer tap
facilities.description: Official seasonal tap about 2.5 km from Nynäs slott. Not year-round; verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Brevik side water point
facilities.description: Mapped Brevik-area drinking-water point near the tenting/service cluster. Treat as seasonal/current-check because the official stage page describes summer water.

facilities.name: Brevik toilet
facilities.description: Toilet at/near Brevik tenting/parking area, corroborated by shelter-map and official descriptions. Verify season/current condition.

facilities.name: Brevik fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped firepit in the Brevik service cluster. Use only under current Nynäs reserve fire rules: managed fireplaces, provided wood, and no fire ban.

facilities.name: Brevik rest shelter
facilities.description: Mapped shelter/rest structure near Brevik; treat as rest/weather shelter, not the official overnight wind shelter.

facilities.name: Brevik parking / Nynäs brygga access
facilities.description: Spacious parking area by the road toward Nynäs brygga; also access to non-Sörmlandsleden trails around Brevikshalvön, Furholmen, and Stäksö.

facilities.name: Nynäs brygga / Brevik side services
facilities.description: Nearby side-service cluster with small beach, mapped toilet/water/picnic/waste/boat-slip context; user reports also mention toilets and picnic tables near this parking/rest area. Show as adjacent Brevik option, not part of the main Sörmlandsleden line.

facilities.name: Nynäs brygga waste point
facilities.description: Mapped waste/trash point in the Nynäs brygga side-service cluster. Availability can change; carry out rubbish if bins are missing/full.

facilities.name: Stage 52 cattle/pasture caution
facilities.description: Official notes say grazing animals can occur in a pasture on the stage. User reports mention cattle, calves, and a bull in the area. Keep dogs controlled, give animals space, and close gates.

facilities.name: Shingle field / klapperstensfält
facilities.description: Official route description passes a shingle field after the climb from Brevik. Approximate terrain marker derived from route sequence.

facilities.name: Stage 52 giant's kettle
facilities.description: Official route description passes a giant's kettle after the shingle field. Approximate pin derived from route sequence until field-verified.

facilities.name: Rösten homestead context
facilities.description: The route passes the Rösten homestead before turning toward Röstensberget. Private/heritage landscape context, not a public service.

facilities.name: Röstensberget viewpoint
facilities.description: Recommended ridge/viewpoint over Tvären and toward Studsvik; stage steward recommends the south-end bench. User reports call this one of the stage highlights.

facilities.name: Tvärens strand / Lerviken shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter by Tvären after about 6 km, described by users as a strong waterside rest/lunch point. Shelter-map sources describe about 6 sleeping places; a recent comment reported it in good condition with firewood, but do not guarantee firewood.

facilities.name: Tvärens shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared shelter fireplace context. In Nynäs reserve, fires/grilling are only allowed at reserve-managed fireplaces with provided wood and only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Tvärens / Lerviken toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet near the Tvären/Lerviken shelter; verify condition before relying on it.

facilities.name: Tvären shore water
facilities.description: Coastal/brackish surface-water context only; not a practical potable source. Carry or use the seasonal taps.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats stage junction
facilities.description: Stage 52 local-route endpoint and connection to stage 53 and 53:1. The official tap/badplats coordinate is slightly west at 58.795133, 17.418150.

facilities.name: Sandviks camping
facilities.description: Paid/simple camping west of Sandviks badplats. Nynäs describes tent/caravan/campervan pitches for a fee, a modern service building, no booking requirement, and 2026 opening from 1 May; user/Komoot notes mention self-service outside staffed times. Open season/payment details can change.

facilities.name: Sandviks camping recycling
facilities.description: Mapped recycling/waste point by Sandviks camping. Treat as camping/service-area context, not guaranteed public trash service.

facilities.name: Sandvik badplats summer tap
facilities.description: Official seasonal tap at Sandviks badplats/camping after about 7 km and near the stage end. Verify season/current function.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet at the Sandviks badplats end area. Verify season/current condition.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped fireplace at the badplats. Fire use is governed by Nynäs reserve rules and current fire bans.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats bathing-water check
facilities.description: Official bathing-water page listed the latest 2025 sample as tjänligt with no algal bloom and the 2025 classification valid for the 2026 season as good quality. 2026 sample period is 21 June-15 August; possible pollution sources include runoff/rain and Studsvik wastewater outlet but assessed risk/frequency is low. Check current samples during the season.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats soft-bottom caution
facilities.description: User bathing-site reviews are mixed; one later review warns of very soft clay under parts of the sand. Treat as localized swimming-bottom caution, not a trail-condition issue.

facilities.name: Sandviks east beach fireplace
facilities.description: Additional mapped beach firepit east of the stage end; show as nearby and use only under current reserve/camping fire rules.

facilities.name: Sandviks camping toilets/showers
facilities.description: Camping/service-building context with toilets/showers in season; public access may depend on camping operations.

facilities.name: Sandviks badplats parking
facilities.description: Parking at/near Sandviks badplats per official stage text and Naturkartan.

facilities.name: Studsvik bus access for Sandvik
facilities.description: Distant bus access for the Sandviks end, roughly 3.6 km direct-line and likely 4-5+ km by roads/paths. Treat as fallback/distant access, not a close trailhead, and verify live Sörmlandstrafiken routing.

facilities.name: Sandvik 53:1 branch topology
facilities.description: Stage 53:1 starts roughly 230-245 m east of the Stage 52/53 shared point, along the early Stage 53/Sandvik area. Treat Sandviks badplats as a service cluster; route-building from 52 to 53:1 should include this short connector.

facilities.name: Sandvik side-road navigation watch
facilities.description: A hiker report described a wrong turn from the cottage/camping-side area toward Sandvik that added about 1 km. Watch the orange route at side roads, camping tracks, and cottage/service paths.

facilities.name: Current fire-ban check
facilities.description: Live fire-ban status can change quickly. Check Krisinformation or the municipality the same day; stricter bans can also affect fixed public grill sites.

facilities.name: Nynäs reserve camping/fire rules
facilities.description: In Nynäs reserve, overnighting is only allowed at designated places and fires/grilling only at reserve-managed fireplaces with provided wood; Sandviks camping follows its own camping rules. The reserve is managed by Region Sörmland and has a 2023 decision/management plan.
